title: Singular and Plural Nouns in Biology
objective: Students control plural forms, countable nouns, and common scientific irregular plurals.
context: Lab note with errors: “Each shells is small. Many branch are long. We need two information about the tree.”

items.hint: Each takes a singular count noun.
Many takes a plural count noun.

items.prompt: Repair the last sentence. Keep the number two.
items.answer: We need two pieces of information about the tree.
